brief.summary: Polished, sensual minimalism in a warm neutral palette: oversized camel and chocolate tailoring, fine knits and silk slips, tonal head-to-toe dressing in cream, taupe and brown, finished with gold jewellery, sleek hair and a pointed heel. Long lines and a little skin (a slip, an open collar) keep it soft rather than severe; nothing is fussy.
signatures: oversized camel or chocolate wool coat over tonal knit and trousers
fine-gauge cashmere roll neck or polo with wide tailored trousers
bias-cut silk slip skirt or dress under a long coat or oversized blazer
double-breasted oversized blazer with straight jeans or matching trousers
tonal cream, beige and taupe dressing head to toe
leather trousers or a leather midi skirt with a soft knit
pointed slingbacks, knee boots, sleek mules
structured leather top-handle or shoulder bag, tan or black
fine gold chains, hoops and small sunglasses
